ex.en: He wishes to erase bad memories.
ex.zh: 他希望抹去不好的回憶。

ex.en: I erased the blackboard for the teacher.
ex.zh: 我幫老師擦黑板。

ex.en: I accidentally erased all the files on the drive.
ex.zh: 我不小心刪除了硬碟裡所有的檔案。

erase.en: to remove writing, marks or information completely

ex.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
ex.zh: 如果系統工程師持續離職，公司的競爭優勢將會被削弱。

ex.en: This will erode our credibility.
ex.zh: 這會損害我們的信譽。

ex.en: The sea has slowly eroded the cliffs.
ex.zh: 海水慢慢侵蝕了懸崖。

erode.en: to slowly make something weaker, or to wear it away

ex.en: Correct the errors if there are any.
ex.zh: 如果有錯誤，請改正。

ex.en: My data-burning software is showing an error message.
ex.zh: 我的燒錄軟體出現錯誤訊息。

ex.en: Can you confirm that it is a correctable error?
ex.zh: 你能確認那是可以修正的錯誤嗎？

error.en: something that is wrong, a mistake

ex.en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
ex.zh: 電晶體的發明開啟了一個新時代。

ex.en: The revolution ushered in a new era.
ex.zh: 革命帶來了新時代。

ex.en: In the era of email, I'm so happy when a friend sends me a real letter.
ex.zh: 在這個電子郵件的時代，朋友寄給我一封真正的信，我會非常開心。

era.en: a long period of time with a special character

ex.en: The report was based on erroneous information.
ex.zh: 這份報告是根據錯誤的資訊寫成的。

ex.en: Many people hold the erroneous belief that shy people are unfriendly.
ex.zh: 許多人錯誤地以為害羞的人不友善。

ex.en: After all, even the gods may err at times.
ex.zh: 畢竟，即使是神也會偶爾出差錯。

ex.en: To err is human.
ex.zh: 犯錯是人之常情。

ex.en: Forgive me for being frank. You have erred.
ex.zh: 恕我直言：你犯了一個錯。

ex.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?
ex.zh: 我要去辦幾件事，你要一起來嗎？

ex.en: Tom is out on an errand.
ex.zh: Tom出去辦事了。

ex.en: I asked my brother to run an errand to the post office for me.
ex.zh: 我請弟弟幫我跑一趟郵局。

errand.en: a short trip to do a small job

ex.en: The office ordered ergonomic chairs for the staff.
ex.zh: 辦公室為員工訂購了符合人體工學的椅子。

ex.en: An ergonomic keyboard can reduce wrist strain.
ex.zh: 符合人體工學的鍵盤能減輕手腕負擔。

ergonomic.en: designed to be comfortable and safe for the human body

ex.en: The soldiers stood erect while the flag was raised.
ex.zh: 升旗時，士兵們挺直地站著。

ex.en: She walked with her head erect and her shoulders back.
ex.zh: 她抬頭挺胸地走著。

ex.en: They plan to erect a statue in the town square.
ex.zh: 他們打算在鎮上的廣場豎立一座雕像。

ex.en: The workers erected the tent in less than an hour.
ex.zh: 工人們不到一小時就搭好了帳篷。

ex.en: Heavy rain causes soil erosion on the steep hills.
ex.zh: 大雨會使陡峭的山坡出現土壤侵蝕。

ex.en: Beach erosion is a growing problem along the coast.
ex.zh: 海灘侵蝕是沿海地區日益嚴重的問題。

ex.en: There has been an erosion of trust between the two sides.
ex.zh: 雙方之間的信任逐漸流失。

ex.en: Inflation leads to the erosion of our savings.
ex.zh: 通貨膨脹使我們的存款逐漸縮水。

ex.en: Well, er, I'm not sure what to say.
ex.zh: 嗯，呃，我不確定該說什麼。

ex.en: It costs, er, about fifty dollars, I think.
ex.zh: 那個要，呃，我想大概五十元。

ex.en: He was rushed to the ER after the accident.
ex.zh: 意外發生後，他被緊急送往急診室。

ex.en: The ER was full of people on Saturday night.
ex.zh: 星期六晚上急診室裡擠滿了人。

ex.en: Eric builds model airplanes in his free time.
ex.zh: 艾瑞克在空閒時會製作飛機模型。

ex.en: Eric is going to meet us at the cafe.
ex.zh: 艾瑞克會到咖啡館和我們碰面。

ex.en: The volcano could erupt at any time.
ex.zh: 這座火山隨時可能爆發。

ex.en: Smoke and ash erupted from the mountain.
ex.zh: 煙和火山灰從山上噴湧而出。

ex.en: The crowd erupted in cheers when the singer came on stage.
ex.zh: 歌手一上台，群眾便爆出歡呼聲。

ex.en: An argument erupted between the two neighbors.
ex.zh: 兩位鄰居之間突然爆發了爭吵。

ex.en: The eruption of the volcano forced thousands to leave their homes.
ex.zh: 火山爆發迫使數千人離開家園。

ex.en: Scientists are watching the mountain for signs of an eruption.
ex.zh: 科學家正在觀察這座山是否有噴發的跡象。

ex.en: An eruption of red spots appeared on his arm.
ex.zh: 他的手臂上突然冒出一片紅疹。

ex.en: The doctor said the skin eruption was caused by an allergy.
ex.zh: 醫生說皮膚起疹是過敏造成的。

ex.en: The world is trying to eradicate this disease completely.
ex.zh: 全世界正努力徹底根除這種疾病。

ex.en: The farmers worked to eradicate the weeds from the field.
ex.zh: 農夫努力清除田裡的雜草。

ex.en: It is hard to eradicate poverty overnight.
ex.zh: 貧窮不可能一夕之間根除。

ex.en: His erratic behavior worried his friends.
ex.zh: 他反覆無常的行為讓朋友擔心。

ex.en: The train service has been erratic all week.
ex.zh: 這個星期火車班次一直很不穩定。

ex.en: The eradication of smallpox was a great success for public health.
ex.zh: 天花的根除是公共衛生的一大成就。

ex.en: The government launched a plan for the eradication of the pest.
ex.zh: 政府推出了消滅這種害蟲的計畫。

ex.en: He met his erstwhile classmates at the reunion.
ex.zh: 他在同學會上遇見昔日的同學。

ex.en: The erstwhile champion lost in the first round.
ex.zh: 這位前冠軍在第一輪就輸了。

ex.en: An errant ball flew over the fence into the garden.
ex.zh: 一顆亂飛的球越過圍籬飛進花園。

ex.en: The teacher tried to guide the errant student back on track.
ex.zh: 老師努力引導誤入歧途的學生回到正軌。

eroding.zh: 侵蝕；逐漸削弱（現在分詞）

ex.en: The river is slowly eroding the bank.
ex.zh: 河水正慢慢侵蝕河岸。

ex.en: Constant lies are eroding people's trust in him.
ex.zh: 不斷的謊言正逐漸削弱大家對他的信任。

ex.en: Can I borrow your eraser to fix this mistake?
ex.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦來改這個錯誤嗎？

ex.en: The teacher used an eraser to clean the board.
ex.zh: 老師用板擦把黑板擦乾淨。

ex.en: The article erroneously stated that the shop was closed.
ex.zh: 那篇文章錯誤地寫說這家店已經歇業。

ex.en: He erroneously believed the exam was on Friday.
ex.zh: 他錯以為考試在星期五。
